text.p: Smith Barney's bank analyst lowered its recommendation on Hambrecht & Quist Inc "as takeover craze bloats (its) valuation."
-- According to the analyst's research note, the downgrade comes "as the stock has soared on takeover speculation, not on changing fundamentals."

-- "The rapid and almost unrelenting rise in the price of these shares has pushed valuations to levels that defy the underlying fundamental dynamics of this sector as trading volumes have deteriorated, underwriting activity has become choppy, and operating margins have come under pressure from infrastructure growth," according to the note.
-- Since the end of May, Hambrecht shares have risen to about 35 from around 15 in recent trading sessions.
-- In morning New York Stock Exchange trade, the shares were off 3-1/2, or almost 10 percent, to 30-5/8.
